evidenceBoundary: Convert runs inside the manifest-granted ExtensionHost in Chromium. A local deterministic host implements only storage, toast, and download observation; tests use synthetic SVG, JSON, PDF, Markdown, and WAV fixtures and inspect the actual downloaded bytes, ZIP entries, PDF pages/text/rotation, and image dimensions/pixels. No hosted converter, customer file, external model/provider, or live service is used. FileChooser tests exercise the browser file input path; they do not prove a native operating-system picker. AVIF output is conditional on browser codec support, and other format fidelity remains limited to the local adapters exercised by these fixtures.
